accesses.account: DEFINE ACCESS account ON DATABASE TYPE RECORD SIGNUP (CREATE person SET email = $email, name = $name) SIGNIN (SELECT * FROM person WHERE email = $email) WITH REFRESH WITH JWT ALGORITHM HS512 KEY '[REDACTED]' WITH ISSUER KEY '[REDACTED]' DURATION FOR GRANT 4w2d, FOR TOKEN 15m, FOR SESSION 12h COMMENT 'record users'
accesses.operators: DEFINE ACCESS operators ON DATABASE TYPE BEARER FOR USER DURATION FOR GRANT 4w2d, FOR TOKEN 1h, FOR SESSION NONE
accesses.remote_jwt: DEFINE ACCESS remote_jwt ON DATABASE TYPE JWT URL 'https://example.com/.well-known/jwks.json' DURATION FOR SESSION 2h
accesses.service: DEFINE ACCESS service ON DATABASE TYPE BEARER FOR RECORD DURATION FOR GRANT 4w2d, FOR TOKEN 15m, FOR SESSION NONE
accesses.shared_jwt: DEFINE ACCESS shared_jwt ON DATABASE TYPE JWT ALGORITHM HS256 KEY '[REDACTED]' WITH ISSUER KEY '[REDACTED]' DURATION FOR TOKEN 1h, FOR SESSION NONE

analyzers.prepped: DEFINE ANALYZER prepped FUNCTION fn::prep TOKENIZERS BLANK FILTERS LOWERCASE, EDGENGRAM(2,10)
analyzers.simple: DEFINE ANALYZER simple TOKENIZERS BLANK,CLASS FILTERS LOWERCASE, ASCII, SNOWBALL(ENGLISH) COMMENT 'plain text'

apis./docs: DEFINE API '/docs' FOR any PERMISSIONS FULL FOR get, post MIDDLEWARE api::timeout(1s) PERMISSIONS FULL THEN { RETURN { status: 200 } }
apis./greet/:name: DEFINE API '/greet/:name' FOR any PERMISSIONS FULL FOR get PERMISSIONS FULL THEN { RETURN { status: 200, body: fn::greet($request.params.name) } }

buckets.avatars: DEFINE BUCKET avatars BACKEND 'memory' PERMISSIONS FULL COMMENT 'profile images'
buckets.docs: DEFINE BUCKET docs READONLY BACKEND 'memory' PERMISSIONS FULL

functions.doc::related: DEFINE FUNCTION fn::doc::related($d: record<doc>, $tags: set<string>) -> array<record<doc>> { RETURN [$d] } PERMISSIONS NONE
functions.double: DEFINE FUNCTION fn::double($x: int) { RETURN $x * 2 } PERMISSIONS FULL
functions.greet: DEFINE FUNCTION fn::greet($name: string, $greeting: none | string, $times: none | int) -> string { RETURN ($greeting ?? 'hello') + ' ' + $name } COMMENT 'greets someone' PERMISSIONS FULL
functions.now: DEFINE FUNCTION fn::now() -> datetime { RETURN time::now() } PERMISSIONS WHERE $auth.admin = true
functions.optional_first: DEFINE FUNCTION fn::optional_first($a: none | int, $b: int) -> int { RETURN $b } PERMISSIONS FULL
functions.prep: DEFINE FUNCTION fn::prep($s: string) -> string { RETURN string::lowercase($s) } PERMISSIONS FULL

modules.mod::demo: DEFINE MODULE mod::demo FROM f"avatars:/demo.wasm" UNSIGNED PERMISSIONS FULL

params.app_name: DEFINE PARAM $app_name VALUE 'corpus' COMMENT 'application name' PERMISSIONS FULL
params.limits: DEFINE PARAM $limits VALUE { max: 10, ratio: 0.5dec } PERMISSIONS NONE

sequences.order_number: DEFINE SEQUENCE order_number BATCH 100 START 1000 TIMEOUT 5s

tables.adults: DEFINE TABLE adults TYPE ANY SCHEMALESS AS SELECT name, age FROM person WHERE age >= 18 PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.anything: DEFINE TABLE anything TYPE ANY SCHEMALESS PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.attachment: DEFINE TABLE attachment TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.audit_log: DEFINE TABLE audit_log TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL CHANGEFEED 1d INCLUDE ORIGINAL PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.bag: DEFINE TABLE bag TYPE ANY SCHEMALESS PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.doc: DEFINE TABLE doc TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.follows: DEFINE TABLE follows TYPE RELATION IN person OUT person SCHEMALESS PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.id_array: DEFINE TABLE id_array TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.id_implicit: DEFINE TABLE id_implicit TYPE ANY SCHEMALESS PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.id_int: DEFINE TABLE id_int TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.id_object: DEFINE TABLE id_object TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.id_string: DEFINE TABLE id_string TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.id_union: DEFINE TABLE id_union TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.id_uuid: DEFINE TABLE id_uuid TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.kinds: DEFINE TABLE kinds TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL COMMENT 'one field per value kind' PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.knows: DEFINE TABLE knows TYPE RELATION IN person OUT person ENFORCED LIGHTWEIGHT SCHEMALESS PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.ledger: DEFINE TABLE ledger TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL CHANGEFEED 1w PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.likes: DEFINE TABLE likes TYPE RELATION SCHEMALESS PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.member_of: DEFINE TABLE member_of TYPE RELATION IN person OUT team | org ENFORCED SCHEMAFULL PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.org: DEFINE TABLE org TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL COMMENT "it's an \"organisation\"" PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.person: DEFINE TABLE person TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL COMMENT 'people who can sign in' PERMISSIONS FOR select FULL, FOR create, update WHERE $auth.id = id, FOR delete NONE
tables.purchase: DEFINE TABLE purchase TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.rates: DEFINE TABLE rates TYPE RELATION IN person OUT doc SCHEMAFULL PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.sink: DEFINE TABLE sink TYPE NORMAL DROP SCHEMAFULL PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.team: DEFINE TABLE team TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL PERMISSIONS FULL
tables.team_size: DEFINE TABLE team_size TYPE ANY SCHEMALESS AS SELECT count() AS total, team FROM person GROUP BY team PERMISSIONS NONE

users.reader: DEFINE USER reader ON DATABASE PASSHASH '[REDACTED]' PASSSCRAM '[REDACTED]' ROLES VIEWER DURATION FOR TOKEN 1h, FOR SESSION 1h COMMENT 'read only'
